name: Aanya Rao
headline: Backend-leaning full-stack developer · final-year CS
summary: Final-year CS student who likes building APIs and shipping small products end to end.

bullets: Built a Flask + PostgreSQL portal used by 1,200 students to register for placement drives
Cut report generation time from 40 minutes to 3 minutes by moving Excel exports to SQL queries
Wrote unit tests with Pytest for the eligibility rules engine

projects.name: QueueLess
bullets: Built a FastAPI service that issues virtual tokens for canteen queues, with Redis for live queue state
Containerized the API and Redis with Docker Compose for one-command local setup
Handled 300 concurrent users in a load test with Locust after adding connection pooling

projects.name: StudySync
bullets: Built a React + Node.js app where study groups share notes and schedule sessions
Designed MongoDB schemas for groups, notes and invites with role-based access
Added real-time updates with WebSockets so new notes appear instantly

projects.name: PaperTrail
bullets: Built a RAG chatbot that answers questions over 50 past exam papers with source citations
Evaluated answer accuracy on 40 hand-written questions and fixed retrieval misses

projects.name: Pixel Pets
bullets: Made a browser game with sprite animation and local high scores

achievements: Top 10 of 240 teams at Smart India Hackathon internal round 2024
